applies_to: Marley cooling towers and CoolBoost fluid coolers with AIO, SPPC, ABH or CoolBoost control panels, monitored through a LINK add-on panel.
summary: The MarleyGard LINK is an add-on enclosure with a Contemporary Controls BAScontrol22C I/O module that turns status contacts and 4-20 mA signals from a Marley tower control panel into BACnet/IP objects. It is a monitoring interface: inputs cover vibration, gearbox oil level, basin level and temperature, makeup water, basin heater, and on CoolBoost fluid coolers the spray pumps and dampers. Marley VFDs with a LINK interface connect over Ethernet separately.
notes: This is Marley's 'typical' input assignment; the module is programmed per job, so the actual points vary.
CoolBoost fluid cooler panels use a second I/O module (Module 2), a separate BACnet device whose instances overlap Module 1's.
AI 8 VIB_LVL_XMTR is listed twice in the guide (panel- or switch-powered transmitter); it is one object.
Binary inputs use normally open field contacts unless noted.
The table has no access column; all objects are inputs and are marked read-only.

integration.summary: Plug the BMS into the LINK panel's RJ45 port, browse to the module (default 192.168.92.68), set the IP settings and a unique BACnet device instance and name, then discover and read the inputs. The panel only monitors; start/stop and speed stay with the Marley control panel or VFD.

minimum_points.name: WATER_TEMP_CWB
minimum_points.why: Basin water temp; raw 4-20 mA, scale in the BMS

setup: Default IP address 192.168.92.68; the web pages need a login (default credentials are in the manual - change them).
Choose DHCP or a static IP with mask, gateway and DNS on the System Configuration page.
Enter a BACnet Device Instance and Device Object Name that are unique across the whole internetwork.
Each LINK panel carries the cooling tower order number on the inside of the door; quote it for support.
gotchas: The web page can force point values for testing; forced values stay until unchecked or the module is power-cycled.
CoolBoost panels have two I/O modules (two BACnet devices) with overlapping BI numbers.
Points are pre-programmed per project, so confirm the live object list against the job submittal.
